usageNotes: Use this to inspect the full configuration of a specific LDAP authentication realm configured in Proxmox Datacenter Manager, including server addresses, bind DN, TLS mode, sync attribute mappings, and sync defaults. Requires the System.Audit privilege on the access/domains path — API tokens are supported. Note that the bind-dn credential (password) is not returned; only the structural config is exposed.

examples.summary: Retrieve the configuration for an LDAP realm named 'corp-ad'

tips: The response omits the bind password even if one is configured — use this call only to verify structural settings, not credential presence.
Check the 'mode' field (ldap / ldap+starttls / ldaps) and 'verify' flag together when troubleshooting TLS handshake failures during user sync.
If 'default' is true, this realm is pre-selected on the PDM login screen — changing it affects all users who rely on the default.
sync-attributes and sync-defaults-options are returned as formatted strings (comma-separated key=value pairs), not nested objects.
